messages.subject: sem formative indicators lavaan
parts:
I would like to know if I can elaborate the model of image 1 in the lavaan package (I try, but I attach the result and the errors).

P.D. I tried to use cSEM and SEMinR, but I got more errors in the syntax, so I found myself a bit desperate and I would be infinitely grateful if you can help me, thank you very much.

parts: I think that for such a model to be identified you need to regress at least one variable on every formative factor. In this case, all your formative factors are regressors of another one, which is ok, but I think the cycle NMR <-> CAP makes the model non-recursive.
